semantics.implementationStatus: UNVERIFIED_IN_PB means this artifact does not claim the current PB codebase implements the entry; runtime/backend probing and verified vectors must promote it.

generationPolicy.allow: eligible for generation after backend/vector/policy validation
generationPolicy.compat: interoperability support; not necessarily PB default
generationPolicy.verify-only: parse/verify historical objects; do not generate
generationPolicy.decrypt-only: legacy decryption only under explicit policy
generationPolicy.deny-new-use: recognized but forbidden for new cryptographic use

coverageBoundary.claim: Comprehensive within this turn across major standardized, deployed, historical, deprecated, broken, dangerous, PQC, quantum-native, cryptanalytic, protocol-registered, and research families. It is not a logically exhaustive enumeration of every cryptographic paper, proprietary construction, private-use code point, or unpublished algorithm ever created.
coverageBoundary.unknownHandling: Unknown identifiers must remain UNKNOWN/UNREGISTERED for verification and CANDIDATE for ingestion; never guess equivalence.
